scenarios.title: New records are copied from Source to Target
scenarios.setup: Create 2 test records in Source with invented data (ID TEST-001 and TEST-002).
scenarios.expected: Run succeeds; the log says 2 records sent; both appear in Target.

scenarios.title: Target is down for one record
scenarios.setup: Ask the Target team to make TEST-002 fail on purpose.
scenarios.expected: TEST-001 is sent; the log lists TEST-002 as failed; the run ends Failed with a friendly message.

scenarios.title: Expired test credential
scenarios.setup: In the sandbox, edit the Source API test credential with a wrong value.
scenarios.expected: Run ends Failed with a message asking to update the credential.

tests.why: This is the main purpose of the workflow.
after: Confirm the records were not changed in Source.
Search TEST-001 and TEST-002 and send a screenshot.

tests.check: That one failure does not stop the others.
tests.why: In production one bad record must not block the rest.
before: Prepare a rule that rejects TEST-002.
after: Confirm TEST-001 arrived and TEST-002 did not.
tests.note: Remove the rule after the test.
